title: Algeria seasonal rainfall outlook over stable cropland (NMME, verified test, experimental)
title_fr: Prévision saisonnière des pluies sur les terres cultivées stables de l'Algérie (NMME, test vérifié, expérimental)
description: Experimental tercile probabilities of 3-month rainfall over each wilaya's stable cropland, from the NMME multi-model forecast issued 2026-11-01, recalibrated against CHIRPS v3.0 over 1991–2021 and published only where cross-validated hindcasts beat climatology; full verification tables included.
purpose: Test whether seasonal forecasts can give usable early warning of dry seasons on Algerian farmland, and show plainly where they cannot.

provider.name: Algeria Earth Observatory (calibration and verification); NOAA CPC (NMME forecasts)

creator: Algeria Earth Observatory maintainers
license_notes: NMME forecasts are distributed openly by NOAA CPC; CHIRPS is CC BY 4.0. AEO outlooks and verification are CC BY 4.0.
citation: Algeria Earth Observatory (2026). Algeria seasonal rainfall outlook over stable cropland (NMME, experimental), version 0.1.0. — NMME: Kirtman et al. (2014), BAMS, doi:10.1175/BAMS-D-12-00050.1.

references.citation: Kirtman, B. P. et al. (2014). The North American Multimodel Ensemble: Phase-1 seasonal-to-interannual prediction; Phase-2 toward developing intraseasonal prediction. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society 95, 585–601.
Funk, C. et al. (2026). The Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation with Stations, Version 3. Scientific Data.

spatial_extent.description: Stable cropland of the wilayas with at least 10,000 ha of it (45 wilayas) and of Algeria as a whole.

temporal_extent.description: Hindcasts 1991–2021; latest issue 2026-11-01 (targets up to 6 months ahead).

variables.name: p_below / p_normal / p_above
variables.description: Published tercile probabilities (equal chances where not skilful)

variables.name: skilful
variables.description: Local skill and field significance (≥ 20 % of wilayas, lead ≤ 3 months)

processing: Regression of observed CHIRPS seasonal totals on the NMME ensemble mean over stable cropland, leave-one-year-out; Gaussian tercile probabilities; publication gated by RPSS, ROC area, correlation and field significance.
validation: 3,036 combinations verified (wilaya × start month × lead); 17 % locally skilful against about 5 % expected by chance; skill is concentrated in leads of 1–3 months and in some seasons.
limitations: Experimental test; not an official forecast.
Seasonal rainfall forecasts for North Africa have low skill; most outlooks are 'equal chances'.
Calibration on 31 years; skill estimates are uncertain.
NMME ensemble mean only (no member spread).
algeria_notes: Skill exists mainly for forecasts started in March, May, July, September and November, one to three months ahead, and for the north of the country; forecasts started in October, December and January show almost none.

access.label: Hindcast verification by wilaya, start month and lead (CSV)

verification.notes: See PROVENANCE.json for every input file with its SHA-256.
